content_of_post_to_answer: Why do I have so many questions in my mind?
answer: Having many questions in your mind is often less about confusion and more about awareness. Some people move through life by accepting the first explanation they find; others notice contradictions, possibilities, and gaps that demand deeper understanding. The challenge is not having questions, but learning which questions deserve your attention. A curious mind can become either a tool for discovery or a source of endless noise. The difference is whether you use questions to explore reality or to avoid facing it.
